## ParseError.(constructor)

Keeps the original Go fields. Message is the formatted upstream error; Text is its unformatted diagnostic, and File is the result returned with it.

**Signature:**

```typescript
constructor(Message: GoString, Filename: GoString, Pos: SyntaxPos, Text: GoString, Incomplete: boolean, File: File | null);
```
